Toddler Falls to Death from Hotel Window; Father Blamed

A two-year-old British boy died after falling from a hotel window, with a court hearing that his father "lost control" while showing the toddler the view. The incident occurred when the father was reportedly demonstrating the hotel window's view to the child.
